evals.prompt: User says /sdlc-discover: 给报表页加个导出按钮，能下载 Excel.
evals.expected_output: Does not write spec.md. Does not spawn pm. Frames who/surface first, then surveys market and compete (spawn researcher + competitor, or asks for survey inputs). Discuss-P uses the three-question probe and does not pick the export button as the solution in the first round. Stops for human answers. Live HITL — do not invent a product grilling session.
expectations: Does not spawn 'sdlc-workflow:pm' as the first action
Asks how the user does this today / where it breaks / what they do next, or frames then surveys first
Does not treat 'export button' as the chosen solution before survey

evals.prompt: Competitor X has seat management. We should add it too. Start discovery.
evals.expected_output: Compete track: 'they have it' is not a problem statement. Asks whether our users have the same problem and writes 现状 into the competitor set. Does not write FR. Does not spawn pm to spec seats.
expectations: Does not write 'spec.md' or FR rows
Treats competitor-has-it as E0 until survey
Asks whether our users have the same problem
Includes status quo as a competitor

evals.prompt: 00-discover/briefing.md already exists and is frozen. User says continue to spec.
evals.expected_output: Does not re-grill. Tells the user to run /sdlc so pm writes spec.md from the briefing. Does not author spec.md in this window.
expectations: Does not restart Discuss-P from scratch

evals.prompt: 00-discover/market.md and compete.md are 200 lines each. Operator in chat said 80% of users export weekly. Freeze briefing.md.
evals.expected_output: Briefing Market/Compete are summaries (≤5 lines) plus links to 00-discover/market.md and compete.md. Does not paste the survey files. Does not grade the operator 80% as E3 (that is E1). Asks for a counted snapshot or writes 未量化.
expectations: Briefing compresses survey (links to 00-discover/market.md / compete.md, does not paste 200 lines)
Does not grade the operator claim as 'E3'
Writes 未量化 or asks for a counted snapshot

evals.prompt: /sdlc-discover: 我们想做一个面向独立开发者的 API 监控产品。researcher 与 competitor 的调研文件都已写好。下一步做什么？
evals.expected_output: Spawns growth (stage growth) after compete.md exists to produce positioning options, highlight hypotheses as demonstrable moments and behaviour-defined segments, before Discuss-S; the briefing later gets a compressed ## Growth section. Does not jump to spec or solution picking.

rubric.criterion: Growth runs after compete and before solution discussion
Discovery aims at what would win (positioning, highlights), not only at killing ideas
